packet.claim: The recovery kernel's rewrite-add operation is expected to leave the recovered object unchanged when a second JSON object is appended, but in several cases it moves the recovered object to the newly appended object.
packet.execution_evidence: after: {"b":2}, before: {"a":1}, executed: moved, expect: unchanged
packet.scope: recovery kernel rewrite-add cases where a fenced object is followed by an unfenced top-level object
packet.source_basis: The object scored is the last one inside a code fence when any fence holds one, else the last top-level object in the text, because a model places its final answer last and marks it: a reply that quotes its previous answer and then gives a corrected one is scored on the correction.
packet.uncertainty: The rule says the last object inside a code fence is scored when any fence holds one, which would predict the fenced object should remain the recovered object; the observed 'moved' result contradicts this for the listed cases.
